acceptance_checks: npm run build が成功する
図生成スクリプトが .shiki/ を読んで Mermaid を出力し、コミット済みの生成物と一致する（不一致なら CI 失敗）
Pages デプロイ workflow が成功し、公開 URL が HTTP 200 を返す
サイトに日本語の「GitHub: Pull Request」ページと「Shiki 内部フロー」ページが表示される
Shiki の required checks（validate / CCA / MergeGate）が green

findings.detail: pages.yml runs `npm test` (vitest over tools/**), which covers buildMermaid/loadShikiState well, and a drift check for the artifact. But the task/plan's canonical `test_command` is `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` (tests/test_diagram_integrity.py), which this workflow never executes. That suite presumably runs via the CCA/verifier required checks (shiki-cca-completion.yml / shiki-validate.yml), not in this diff. Worth confirming the Python suite is actually executed by a required check so the integrity gate isn't dead weight; the suite passes against current committed state either way.
findings.title: Pages workflow runs vitest, not the task's declared test_command (python3 -m unittest)

findings.detail: tests/test_diagram_integrity.py docstring says it 'stays green after the autonomous goal loop appends evidence.' That is true for ledger/task-status volatility (which it deliberately ignores), but test_every_real_*_short_id_is_drawn and test_no_phantom_goal_or_task_ids compare drawn nodes to the live .shiki goals/tasks exactly. If the loop later registers a new Goal or Task without regenerating and committing the diagram, this test fails until `npm run gen:diagram` is re-run. Acceptable for this single-task slice; just a design tension to keep in mind as more tasks land.
findings.title: Diagram integrity test's stability claim only holds for ledger/status churn, not new planning nodes

findings.detail: src/components/Mermaid.astro computes isDark once and calls mermaid.run() at load. Toggling Starlight's theme after render won't re-theme the SVG until reload. Purely cosmetic; not a correctness issue.
findings.title: Mermaid theme is chosen once at hydration and won't follow Starlight dark/light toggles

scope: Astro Starlight を初期化し、(1) GitHub 機能解説ページ1本（Pull Request）と (2) .shiki/ の実データから Mermaid を生成する TypeScript スクリプト＋その図を載せた Shiki 内部フローページ1本を作成し、GitHub Actions で Pages にデプロイするところまでを端から端まで通す。
title: 最初の垂直スライス: Starlight サイトを Pages に公開し、実証跡生成の図を1枚通す
